label: Wave 1 — Existing canonical mapping

orderingRule.description: Deterministic review order without confidence or priority scoring

decisionSemantics.accepted: Human confirms the source term maps to the proposed frozen canonical function for this manual/platform context. Does not promote canonical knowledge.
decisionSemantics.rejected: Human rejects the proposed mapping as incorrect or unsupported by evidence. Does not delete or mutate candidate artifacts.
decisionSemantics.deferred: Human defers review pending more evidence. Does not mutate candidate artifacts.

governanceNote: Review decision is orthogonal to canonical promotion. This wave validates mappings to already-frozen canonical vocabulary only.
